| colspan="7" align="left"|<small>'''Notes:'''</small><br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|reward|<small>1</small>}}<small>Two Reward Challenges were run at the same time: one between a member of each tribe, and one between the rest of the tribes.<br />Romain won the individual race for Makawa against Théotime, and Coravu won the team race.</small><br />
{{note|elim|<small>2</small>}}<small>The five castaways who went to the Lost Paradise beforehand competed in individual elimination challenge. Théotime finished<br />last in the challenge, therefore he was eliminated from the game.</small><br />
{{note|necklace|<small>3</small>}}<small>An Immunity Necklace was played, however, no votes were cast against its user.</small><br />
{{note|deadlock|<small>4</small>}}<small>With a deadlocked tie between Manu and Marvyn, both of them were forced to draw rocks to determine who would be eliminated.</small><br />
{{note|ambassadors|<small>5</small>}}<small>At the ambassadors meeting, Fabian and Marguerite agreed to eliminate Tugdual.</small><br />
{{note|tie|<small>6</small>}}<small>The vote resulted in a tie. Per ''Koh-Lanta'' rules, a revote would commence.</small><br />
{{note|necklace|<small>7</small>}}<small>An Immunity Necklace was played, therefore all votes against the user were negated.</small><br />
{{note|pairs|<small>8</small>}}<small>André was Maxime's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore he was also eliminated when Maxime was voted out.</small><br />
{{note|reward2|<small>9</small>}}<small>A special challenge was held between the two regular challenges, where the winner obtained a clue to an Immunity Necklace.</small><br />
{{note|penalty|<small>10</small>}}<small>Mélanie had a penalty vote against her for losing the immunity challenge, but was negated due to her being evacuated.</small><br />
{{note|reward3|<small>11</small>}}<small>Sandrine used an advantage, so she could have a smaller reward with her daughter.</small><br />
{{note|final4|<small>12</small>}}<small>At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Sandrine came in last and was eliminated.</small>
{{refend}}
